entries.subject: DAMIT model 4172, 2019-05-07; Ďurech et al. (2019)
entries.finding: Convex light-curve shape and paired sidereal spin. The selected archive query lists no alternative model for this target.

entries.subject: NEOWISE v2, Gr12b; Grav et al. (2012)
entries.finding: Effective spherical diameter 60.711 ± 0.982 km; approximate mesh-volume scale.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The grid marks unmapped coverage: no registered global reflectance mosaic was found in the selected releases.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/13030/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.

entries.subject: Integrated colors as a surface map
entries.finding: Disk-integrated colors do not constrain a regolith map. The selected original Gr12b catalog row marks diameter as fitted (`D` in `FIT_CODE`). The CSV row and original query are pinned in the source manifest; [column definitions](https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/data/WISE/NEOWISE_SB/gator_docs/neowisesbprop_colDescriptions.html) are shared.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al
entries.finding: Hanuš et al. (2023), [*Shape models and spin states of Jupiter Trojans: Testing the streaming instability formation scenario*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.05380v1), Table B.3 — adopts this existing DAMIT shape/spin solution. No replacement mesh is required by that survey.
